step1.ptxt: SRS airbag system handling and work precautions (see )

atten2.ptxt: Some of these service operations affect the SRS airbag system, so be sure to read the precautions for the SRS airbag system before starting work.

step1.ptxt: Precautions for Handling and Servicing Steering Column

step2.ptxt: Do not subject the steering column assembly (especially the motor and torque sensor) to impacts. If it has been subjected to a severe impact (such as being dropped on the floor), replace it with a new part.
When carrying the steering column assembly, do not pull on the harness.
